TikiTakaClubStanding.title: TikiTakaClubStanding
TikiTakaClubStanding.description: Public player club profile and standings for the TIKI TAKA 0.2 global online leaderboard ordered by Rank (rankedWins) or Money (balance). Contains no PII.

uid.description: The authenticated Firebase user UID owning this club profile.

iconType.description: Avatar display mode: preset icon or captured camera photo.

presetIcon.description: Preset icon identifier (#10, STAR, BOLT, CROWN, FIRE, TROPHY).

photoDataUrl.description: Optional compact base64 JPEG avatar data URL or empty string when using preset icon.

rankedWins.description: Total ranked/tournament match wins used to compute player rank tier and level.

isPublic.description: Flag indicating this club profile is publicly queryable on the TIKI TAKA 0.2 global leaderboard.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

/tiki_taka_club_standings/{userId}.description: Stores public player profiles for the TIKI TAKA 0.2 online leaderboard ordered by Rank or Money.

/leaderboard_profiles/{userId}.description: Legacy alias collection for public player leaderboard profiles.
